title: HARBOUR COUNCIL MINUTES
key_sentences: The council met on the fourth of March in the old customs house.
Eleven members were present and two sent apologies.
The chair opened the meeting at seven o'clock.
The council agreed to repaint the north pier before the summer season.
A proposal to extend the fish market was postponed until the budget is known.
Members thanked the volunteers who cleared the slipway after the February storm.
